title: Assessing the Applicability of Existing Design Recommendations to AI Companion Design: A Multi-Method Study
abstract: arXiv:2609.14236v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: With the rapid proliferation of large language model (LLM)-based systems, AI companions have emerged as conversational agents designed to cultivate emotional connection rather than primarily to support humans in instrumental tasks. Because engagement with AI companions involves relational, emotional, and potentially long-term interactions, their design is consequential. Prior work has offered guidance for designing trustworthy and relational AI systems and has begun to examine design for AI companionship. However, while such work provides insights into possible design solutions, less is known about what makes AI companion design difficult as a design problem. To examine this challenge, we assessed the applicability of existing design recommendations from adjacent domains in the context of AI companion design. Our multi-method investigation unfolded across four phases: literature review, practitioner co-analysis, internal heuristic eval

translated_title: 评估现有设计建议在AI伴侣设计中的适用性：一项多方法研究
translated_abstract: 随着基于大语言模型（LLM）系统的快速普及，AI伴侣作为一种对话代理应运而生，其设计旨在培养情感连接，而非主要支持人类完成工具性任务。由于与AI伴侣的互动涉及关系性、情感性以及潜在的长期交互，其设计具有重要意义。先前的研究为设计可信赖的关系型AI系统提供了指导，并已开始探索AI伴侣的设计。然而，尽管这些工作为可能的设计方案提供了见解，但对于什么使AI伴侣设计作为一个设计问题变得困难，人们仍知之甚少。为了探究这一挑战，我们评估了来自相邻领域的现有设计建议在AI伴侣设计背景下的适用性。我们的多方法研究分为四个阶段展开：文献综述、从业者共同分析、内部启发式评估……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 该研究通过文献综述、从业者共同分析和启发式评估等多方法研究，评估了相邻领域现有设计建议在AI伴侣设计中的适用性，揭示了使AI伴侣设计成为一个困难设计问题的关键挑战。
en_tdlr: This multi-method study assesses the applicability of existing design recommendations from adjacent domains to AI companion design, revealing key challenges that make AI companion design a difficult design problem.
